item.description:
If you use cock.li, it appears that they are going down, got fedded, something like that, a dead man's switch activated. I would advise looking for a new email service.

https://cock.li/

Cock.li will shut down before becoming complicit in crimes against its own userbase by duress of any government or organization.

For nearly 11 years, cock.li has remained one of the only public e-mail providers to allow registration as anonymously as a library card. The fact that it's still possible to get an e-mail address as easy as 20 years ago is a fact widely hated by international governments; at least the parts of those governments which have dedicated countless resources to target our service, our team, our family, and our friends with illegal surveillance, bad-jacketing, organized disinformation, and much worse.

A combination of these illegal tactics have become so serious that the site is now in grave danger.

The only way it's been possible for cock.li to weather this and stay online is thanks to the dedication of our entire lives to this bit. Our small team of 3-5 people have had our lives permanently altered and our stability sacrificed so Internet users worldwide can more-or-less enjoy the comfort of being able to access e-mail without requiring a phone number or other surveillance document.

Despite the constant attacks on the service and our personal lives, no one directly involved has ever been paid in 11 years for their work on cock.li. The personal costs of this volunteer work add up over a lifetime, and as we get older we've slowly taken steps back to compensate, when we should have been stepping up.

Stepping up is exactly what's needed right now, and we're here to do it. These recent issues have forced us to take leave from our jobs to make time just to keep the wheels spinning. I hope you can understand that is why, for the first time ever, I'm asking you to donate directly to the people who make cock.li possible.

Your donation will make a real difference by telling us to use the money where it will help the most right now. We have a sizable war chest for legal expenses that has never once been used to pay us for our work. Problem is, if we can't make time to put that war chest to work, what good is it? We believe cannibalizing this fund to offset our lost time would put cock.li in a worse position, so by creating a new fund we can make it clear what we're doing while keeping our legal funds secure.

It shouldn't surprise you that the people who are so passionate about this service are not profiteers or business people. We are private, unpaid individuals who don't want to see one of the last great liberties of this Internet fall victim to the criminal and violent attempts to shut it down. If these critical threats force us to change the world to ensure e-mail remains recognized as a human right, we won't hesitate to do it.

We never once asked for personal donations specifically in the hopes that if this moment ever came, our userbase would appreciate that we were able to make it this long on passion alone, and trust that your donation will make the best possible impact.

There is much work to be done. I will keep you updated as much as I can. Thank you very much for your consideration.

item.title: >I'm leaving the sharty (WALL OF TEXT WARNING)
item.description:
99% of these threads are not worth reading, but the OP went through with the effort of writing a wall of text so I read it and agree with some of his points. Since it was on /soy/ the thread is already unrelated to OP and most of you won't see it, so I'm posting it here to see what you guys think about it and my reaction to it, I think discussion on these types of threads would actually be LE GOOD, you just are not going to get that in /soy/.
<
>1. NAS/Jaks with 0 OC and moreso just used to bait the userbase causing ragebait
Theres OC, a problem is a majority of it is not posted on the sharty (or otherwise not seen) but instead posted on the booru or youtube channels or even twitter, (Don't believe me, just go on any of those and see how much content you can find that you never saw on the sharty, its kind of shocking) Baiters gonna Bait, don't be a whiny nutroon about it.
<
I've also always been an advocate of reviving oldCHAD sharty contents back into the spotlight to solve this problem (Think about it, you don't see colorjaks,though,perro…etc as much as you should of, it would make the sharty feel more alive, more original, and be included into OC)
>2. Ongezellig porn/porn in general on the booru and sometimes even on here, this website is for 16 yr olds yet 16 yr olds see interracial porn jokes on here so yes its EPI especially the zellig porn on the booru from 2023
I don't think any action should be taken agaisnt spadesons or Bibisi as a sharty meme,its very funny, and the rest is already banned on sharty, but STRONG AGREE on the booru needing some more jannying (not really in reference to the zellig porn, but to others), we need some patriots in control on the booru, theres alot of posts that shouldn't be there such as there still being sexualized 'litas and posts that are really off in a rule 2 sense.
>3. The hype train is dead. There is no excitement for events (because the managers are lazy) but also theres no good quality raids and nowadays its about doxing literal whos who arent even pedos. Even when they are against literalwhos they arent good quality there isn't a sense of unity in these raids because some spam nigger gore whilst others condemn it and then theres in-fighting and the foodists who spam said niggergore are the ones causing the issue with fastburn raids
Soyim issue 100%, sharty staff do events all the time, sharty staff contribute to the sharty in a level most soyim probably wouldn't expect, SPVA, The 'tok, our own content, and not to forget
>Number one post on /fnac/ made by a janny
>FNAC organized by an admin
>FNAC made by the current mod team
I feel like the feeling of "Stagnation" is just something that comes with using the sharty after a certain period of time and that most of its imagined, we more or less hit our cap in reference to active sharty users IMO but we are not stagnating or dying in any way in terms of our culture or the sharty in general. And all OP would have to do to see these raids he wants revived is make some threads, same with reviving the sharty traiditon of get stealing, but to be fair to OP, I've tried to revive Get stealing and a majority of soyim simply don't give a shit.
>4. The owners of the website are neglectful towards the sharty. After froot "left" the sharty as manager he put in a new cabal of his own that don't reveal themselves with any special names, cult of personnalities which is the issue there is less humanity with these nujannies we don't know half of them or who they are and they add boards, remove boards all the time that dont get used. Heck the old advertisements for said boards are still there yet they havent been removed.
Non issue, Soyim relentlessly dogpiled on ROOT for practically NOTHING which goes to show the current system is fine and doesn't even feel different besides.
>6. Namefags. Most of the sharty namefags cause infighting and their infighting causes their drama to come to boards that have nothing to do with said drama yet the jannies allow them to despite namefagging/avatarfagging not being allowed, we can see the example of this with jo L or Protopoopy.
Ignore, live and let live, in a perfect world staff deal with this, but that OP feels salty about this maybe we should do more, and I have to admit, I also feel like these threads detract from better stuff on the sharty, but its more or less, always been like this, just with funnier characters and people.
>7. Not much community engagement from the jannies or managers like asking users to make banners, or themes, etc which weakens opportunity to show creativity.
OP is quite literally blind, we just did this with ban image submissions and I contributed, theres so much more themes than there was a month ago.
>8. Doing illegal things. Doxing is fine but when you attack a waterplant in Canada or make bombing threats to UK police thats a bad step to get our website glowed up and the more you let this happen the faster our website will be seized by feds.
